versions.name: Roy D. Rivers Wilderness Camp
versions.summary: A Capitol Area Council wilderness property of nearly 400 heavily wooded acres between Smithville and Rosanky, Texas, offering year-round primitive camping with no defined campsites or facilities, suited to backpacking and wilderness survival training.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Capitol Area Council camp page (capitolareascouting.org) and the council's media page listing it among owned camping properties. The source's capitolareascouting.org link was confirmed current. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
